newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-FALLON FREED TO RIDE IN EPSOM CLASSICS.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-FALLON FREED TO RIDE IN EPSOM CLASSICS.

text.p: Leading jockey Kieren Fallon will be riding in the Derby and Oaks at Epsom later this week after his 10-day Italian ban was deferred in Rome on Monday.
The ban, imposed after his mount, Musical Dancer, veered off line in the Italian Derby last month, should have started on Tuesday and ended on June 12.
Fallon plans to appeal against the decision and the disciplinary committee of the Italian jockey club agreed to his request to defer the dates pending the outcome of the appeal hearing.
Fallon can now team up with trainer Henry Cecil's 6-4 on favourite Reams of Verse in the Oaks on Friday.
Fallon will be free to ride the 25-1 outsider, Symonds Inn, in the Derby on Saturday and will also be available to ride in the French Oaks on Sunday if required.
